Name: Element Entry Value ID
Description: The application generated value to uniquely identify the element entry value. Not available when creating new records.

Name: Assignment Number
Description: The number that identifies the person's assignment.

Name: Element Name
Description: The name of the element this entry is for, such as Performance Bonus.

Name: Entry Type
Description: The type of record, such as element entry, or override.

Name: Input Value Name
Description: The name of the input value this element entry value is for.

Name: Legislative Data Group Name
Description: The name of the legislative data group.

Name: Multiple Entry Count
Description: Specify the multiple entry count provided in the element entry record that this value is for.

Name: Element Entry ID
Description: A unique reference to the element entry this input value is for.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment this element entry input value is for.

Name: Element Type ID
Description: A unique reference to the element type.

Name: Entry Value
Description: The entry for input values available for each entry of the element.

Name: HR Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment associated to the employee.

Name: Input Value ID
Description: A unique reference to the input value this value is for.

Name: Legislative Data Group ID
Description: A unique reference to the legislative data group.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
